envelope.description: Show scope and context in the prompts and key the one-shot cache

body.title: Show scope and context in the prompts and key the one-shot cache
body.summary: Show scope, question and context on separate lines in the planning prompt and context as background in synthesis; include scope, question, context and scopeSource in computeCacheKey.
acceptanceChecks: context reaches the planning and synthesis prompts through both handlers and a narrow continuation without changing the named scope
the one-shot cache key differs for a different scope, question, context or scopeSource and is equal for the same request
scopeSource is pinned in cache verification including cached final-report rendering

tests.name: context-prompts.test.ts: context reaches the planning and synthesis prompts through both handlers and a narrow continuation without changing the named scope

cache-key-scope.test.ts: the one-shot computeCacheKey differs for scope, question, context or scopeSource, a cached report renders its own scope line, and isolation is asserted on the one-shot key and the exploration cache
